[[Wain Hughes]] is one of four [[collector]]s located in the Diessa Lowlands. The [[Charr Carving]]s he seeks are ubiquitous drops here and wherever [[Charr]] are found in [[Ascalon]].

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon]]
**{{NPC location|Diessa Lowlands}}

==Dialogue==
:''"I'm searching for 3 ''Charr Carving''s. I can offer you one of the following items in exchange. Can you help me?"''

==Collector items==
{{:Wain Hughes/Collector}}

==Notes==
*The Fire Wand offered by this collector has the only unconditional +5 energy mod on a wand in all of Guild Wars.
*Originally some of the weapons offered primitive stats that were changed, being:
**Ascalon Battle Staff → Damage +25% (vs. Charr)
**Cruel Staff → Damage +25% (vs. Charr)
**Fire Wand → Attack speed +10%, Damage -10%, Damage -10%, Energy +5, Damage +25% (vs. Charr)
